summary.summary:
Migrated withings_api from pydantic 1 to the pydantic 2 API. All 32 tests pass on pydantic 2.14.4.

Changes in withings_api/common.py:
- Custom types TimeZone and ArrowType: replaced the v1 __get_validators__ hook with __get_pydantic_core_schema__ returning a no_info_plain_validator_function. The validate() classmethods are kept (the tests call them directly). Pydantic 2 no longer converts TypeError raised in validators into ValidationError, so a small helper (_type_errors_as_value_errors) re-raises TypeError as ValueError to keep bad input reported as a validation error.
- ConfiguredBaseModel: class Config replaced with model_config = ConfigDict(extra="ignore", frozen=True). allow_mutation=False maps to frozen=True; the old ignore_extra/allow_extra keys were not real v1 settings.
- All @validator(..., pre=True) decorators became @field_validator(..., mode="before") with @classmethod kept underneath.
- Cross-field validators that read values["timezone"] now take info: ValidationInfo and use info.data["timezone"] (GetSleepSummarySerie startdate/enddate/date/modified, MeasureGetMeasResponse updatetime).
- Imports updated (ConfigDict, GetCoreSchemaHandler, ValidationInfo, field_validator, pydantic_core.core_schema); two long signatures wrapped to fit 88 columns.

Changes in pyproject.toml:
- pydantic pin changed from "^1.7.2" to ">=2.0,<3.0". No companion packages (FastAPI, plugins) are pinned in this repo.

Items for review, not changed:
- poetry.lock still pins pydantic 1.x. It needs regenerating with poetry (e.g. poetry lock --no-update) before release.
- The python = "^3.6 || ^3.7" constraint was left as-is. Newer pydantic 2 releases require a newer Python, so it may be worth raising.
- Arrow/tzinfo fields have no custom serializer, so model_dump_json() on models containing them will not produce ISO strings. The v1 code had no serializer either, and no test covers this.
